Synthetic demonstration document (fictional)
Source date: 2025-02-21
Review as-of: 2025-02-21

Service author: Mira Keller, building-heating technician.
Property: Synthetic Rosenweg 33, 8008 Zurich

On 2025-02-21 at07:30, a calibrated digital instrument (calibration check2024-12-15, uncertainty±0.2C) measured the living room at15.8C after overnight normal operation. Main living rooms stayed15.5–16.3C in the seven-day logger record. Resets restore heat briefly; the pump cuts out repeatedly. The fixed circulation pump has an internal bearing/control failure; it is part of landlord-maintained equipment, outside ordinary small tenant maintenance. Normal ventilation and unobstructed radiators were observed; no tenant alteration or misuse explains the failure.

The defect persists at this report's as-of time; no lasting pump repair or replacement has been completed. Heating is inadequate for the contracted winter residential use of the principal living rooms. The proposed remedy is a landlord-arranged pump repair/replacement, with temporary heat while pending. This service finding makes no legal decision and awards no compensation.
